findings.claim: Committed current review intent makes collection self-referential
findings.evidence: The installed instruction says to commit the pending review-collection intent before launch. A corrected expected-path, settled:false current intent committed into captured HEAD still caused incomplete claimed collection. Only the documented commit-after-settlement ordering exception allowed a fresh complete assembly.
findings.premise: Verify the corrected current record schema and distinguish its incomplete state from independently incomplete historical collections.
findings.fixShape: Permit the current invocation’s committed pending intent while validating completed historical records normally.

findings.claim: Unavailable assemblies require a digest their producer never wrote
findings.evidence: A prior assembly failed before writing digest.md; the next assembler rejected its archive for lacking that digest. The run had to add explicitly labelled reconstructed diagnostic digests from immutable selection metadata. Original failed outputs/verdicts were retained.
findings.premise: Verify this archive is a supported failed-selection state and determine the immutable metadata required to identify its unavailable outputs.
findings.fixShape: Represent failed assemblies explicitly so later independent assembly can preserve the failure without demanding nonexistent producer output.

findings.claim: Unknown slot metadata becomes a precise one-slot model
findings.evidence: The ordinary ledger used a JSON-shaped Launch: args line with concurrency4. The profile parser reads textual Launch: mechanism metadata and uses ledger?.concurrency ?? 1. Output reported cap1 beside task/all-agent peak5, model179% of actual, and an estimated47-minute slot benefit.
findings.premise: The recorded JSON launch may violate the ordinary coordinator protocol; do not claim valid native format rejection. Verify fallback/reporting and the missing-metadata path.
findings.fixShape: Keep unknown cap metadata unknown, diagnose its absence, and suppress quantitative slot-bound conclusions requiring that value.

triage: All generalize beyond project, are actionable upstream and carry run evidence; third claim explicitly distinguishes malformed input from unsupported valid-format rejection.
